provenanceClass.A: Native prototype reconstruction: a direct system or application counterpart exists; reference comparison is required.
provenanceClass.B: Period analog adaptation: no direct counterpart, but a close contemporary object or application supplies the genre grammar.
provenanceClass.C: Original period-plausible design: no sufficiently close counterpart; blind-mix review is required and no fake native target may be claimed.

definitions.authoringStatus: How the asset was produced and whether it is technically usable. Image generation is an authoring method, not historical evidence.

historicalReviewStatus.historically-reviewed: Reviewed against target-era family evidence and anachronism risks, but not asserted as a direct native replica.
historicalReviewStatus.reference-validated: Compared with the named direct prototype or reference. This status still does not mean pixel-identical unless an exact-diff field explicitly says so.

definitions.policy: Legacy family reviewStatus is preserved for audit only. It never upgrades historicalReviewStatus.
definitions.runtimeAsset: The ordinary-context runtime asset. runtimeAssetsByContext records compact and desktop selections; compatibilityManifestAsset is not treated as the sole runtime tier.

coverage.remaining40Policy: The forty runtime ids outside priorityCore16 remain historicalReviewStatus=pending in the provenance matrix until individually reviewed. Family completeness, accepted-generated, or technically-clean status must not upgrade them.
